hero.title: Designing Scalable Systems for Content-Heavy Workflows
hero.subtitle: Reduced friction across 100+ programme deliveries by turning a fragile print workflow into a resilient design system.

summary: Optimised a legacy, content-heavy workflow by introducing scalable systems that prioritised design over manual cleanup.

content.text: During my time at HTDL, I worked across 100+ theatre programmes — content-heavy, change-prone documents produced under tight deadlines.

content.alt: Hope Mill Theatre programme showcasing structured layout and typography system

content.text: Rather than treating each programme as a one-off deliverable, I approached the workflow itself as a product.

items: Introduced paragraph and nested styles to eliminate manual formatting
Anchored images to allow layouts to reflow automatically
Designed repeatable layout systems for bios and production lists
Reduced time spent on content cleanup by ~50%

hero.title: Redesigning a Mobile App for Seamless User Experience
hero.subtitle: Improved usability and reduced friction in user onboarding and goal tracking.

summary: Streamlined mobile app workflows to improve user retention and engagement through thoughtful UX and interaction design.

content.text: Led the redesign of a content-heavy mobile application, focusing on reducing friction and improving discoverability of core features.

content.alt: Mobile app showing improved onboarding screens and dashboard

content.text: Implemented a system of in-app guidance tooltips and celebratory animations to enhance user motivation and engagement.

items: Merged multiple challenge pages into one streamlined view
Created live stats and progress trackers on the homepage
Designed celebratory animations for completed goals
Improved profile page layout with supporters, media, and live goals

title: ScriptMate
subtitle: A rehearsal assistant app for amateur actors and directors
overview: For my final year project at the University of Salford, I designed a mobile app that helps amateur actors and directors make the most of their rehearsal time. ScriptMate supports line learning, group collaboration, and performance preparation.
challenge: Amateur theatre groups face low rehearsal attendance, actors underprepared, and directors unable to rehearse full scenes when cast members are missing. The aim was to create a tool that helps actors learn lines faster, enables directors to share scripts digitally, and brings the company together in one organised space.
research: coldRead – strong transcription features but no collaboration.
Line Learner – useful playback options but clunky UX.
Facebook Groups – commonly used for communication, but cluttered and unfocused for rehearsals.
researchInsights: Actors needed line learning and collaboration in one app, not spread across multiple tools.

branding.name: ScriptMate
branding.logo: A highlighted line, symbolising focus and annotation

features: Practice Mode – combines learning, rehearsing, and improving lines with playback & transcription.
Rehearsals – run scenes line-by-line with an automated voice or live with cast members online/offline.
Tasks – Kanban-style board to track progress (To Do → In Progress → Done).
Groups – central hub for cast/crew to share scripts, notes, and messages.
Calendar – plan rehearsals, auditions, and performances.
wireframes: Low-fi wireframes → high-fi prototypes in Adobe XD
Developed consistent reusable components for smoother UX

findings: Layout, usability, and navigation rated Good
Colour scheme was too flat and heavy
improvements: Introduced accent colours and refined UI depth
Merged 'Learn / Rehearse / Improve' into one Practice flow

outcomes: Learn and rehearse lines with transcription and playback
Run group rehearsals online or in person
Stay organised with tasks and calendar
Collaborate in cast groups and share recordings
reflection: Iteration and feedback are crucial to improving design
Following iOS design standards elevated the app
Colour psychology and spacing improved usability
Time management is key in UX projects
futureIdeas: Add custom scripts for new writing and auditions
Assign tasks directly to cast members
Live rehearsals with hidden line prompts
More accessibility options (typed line input, multiple playback voices)
